address: Nation Riviera Beach Club, Corniche Road, Abu Dhabi
bio: A lovely spot on the beach provides the ideal setting for this seafood restaurant. Service is warm and quietly confident; the room is bright and spacious; and the menu wide and varied. There’s quite a Japanese influence, with plenty of nigiri and sashimi; there are also plates for sharing, and good use is made of the charcoal grill. The ‘Blow Torch Dynamite Roll’ makes for an explosive start!
